method_under_test.note: PySCF X2C-1e relativistic Hamiltonian replacing BDF in this work (BDF licence not available on the test machine). sto-3g chosen for wall-time feasibility on M-series Mac; absolute energies are not quantitatively comparable to BDF/Niu-Shuai 2008.

analysis.interpretation: Anthracene contains only C and H (no heavy atoms), so the spin-orbit correction relative to the scalar-relativistic limit is intrinsically tiny (sub-meV). This is consistent with the chemistry: anthracene phosphorescence rate is small and is dominated by vibronic coupling rather than direct SOC. BDF in heavy-atom systems is where SOC magnitude becomes physically important; the present run only certifies the ChemMaster -> PySCF X2C call path.
